matrix-full.description: Full-width matrix display — spans all 12 columns

matrix-main.description: Primary terminal zone — spans 8 of 12 columns

matrix-sidebar.description: System log panel — spans 4 of 12 columns

matrix-split.description: Binary split — two equal terminals with 1px green hairline separator

panel.description: Terminal panel — 1px solid green border at 0.4 opacity, 0 border-radius

_twist.twistDescription: 1200px max-width container (not 1440px editorial — terminal screens are narrower). 20px container padding. 16px gutter — tighter than editorial, wider than CRT terminal (8px too dense). Renamed patterns as .matrix-* vocabulary. Panel borders use rgba(0,255,65,0.4) — matrix green hairlines. feature-grid: repeat(3, 1fr) 16px gap for 3-column card layout. matrix-split: 1fr 1px 1fr with green 1px separator. All border-radius: 0 — terminals have no curves.
